_about: Typing scheme providers: what they publish, their data terms, whether their scheme lists may be collected automatically, and where a permission request stands. Read by scheme_index.py (allowed link hosts); kept up to date by hand. Provider ids match app/logic/scheme_sources.R. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; null means unknown or not applicable.

cgmlst_org.name: cgMLST.org Nomenclature Server
cgmlst_org.commercial_use: Downloads permitted for non-commercial purposes only; commercial use needs Ridom's permission.

listing.reason: The scheme list page /ncs/ is open to automated access; robots.txt disallows only /ncs/schema/ and /ncs/strain/, which the tool never requests.

permission.notes: Users download scheme files themselves; the app never contacts cgmlst.org.

chewie_ns.name: Chewie-NS
chewie_ns.commercial_use: No data licence published for hosted schemas; schemas adapted from other providers can carry those providers' terms.

listing.reason: The public API invites programmatic use and asks for a pause between requests.

permission.notes: Check schema authors' terms before commercial use of a schema.

pubmlst.name: PubMLST
pubmlst.commercial_use: Data submitted up to 2024-12-31 may be used with citation; data from 2025 on is limited to non-commercial academic research and public-health surveillance unless licensed. rMLST is academic only.

listing.reason: Scheme metadata (database and scheme names, locus counts, page links) is read from rest.pubmlst.org with written permission. rMLST is never listed.

permission.granted_by: Dr. Keith Jolley, University of Oxford
permission.conditions: Allowed as long as no scheme data is downloaded or distributed. robots.txt is aimed at crawler bots, not scripted API use. Up to 4 concurrent connections allowed, but sequential requests from a single process are preferred; no pause between calls needed.
permission.notes: Request: weekly automated listing of scheme metadata only, excluding rMLST, identified with a contact address.

pasteur.name: Institut Pasteur BIGSdb
pasteur.commercial_use: Academic, non-commercial use only, no redistribution; other uses need a licence (bigsdb-policy@pasteur.fr).

listing.reason: Scheme metadata (database and scheme names, locus counts, page links) is read from bigsdb.pasteur.fr/api with written confirmation, sequentially with pauses.

permission.granted_by: Thomas Miron, Technology Transfer & Industrial Partnership, Institut Pasteur
permission.conditions: The use as described is acceptable and compliant with the BIGSdb-Pasteur policy: weekly at most, metadata only (no alleles, profiles or isolate data), sequential requests with pauses, identified with a contact address.
permission.notes: Keep the pauses and the contact address in the User-Agent; any wider use needs a new request.

enterobase.name: EnteroBase
enterobase.operator: University of Warwick; the Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Enterococcus databases are hosted by the Leibniz Institute DSMZ
enterobase.commercial_use: Academic use only: the terms bar use 'for any commercial or business purposes whatsoever'; other uses need a licence from the University of Warwick (enterobase@warwick.ac.uk). The DSMZ-hosted databases were not reviewed separately.

listing.reason: The terms exclude business use of the service, so collecting its scheme lists automatically for a commercial product needs permission. Rows linking to its public database pages are curated by hand in curation.csv.

permission.notes: Ask together with a licence question if automated listing or commercial use of EnteroBase schemes is wanted.
